feature: Money path — immediate cancellation (MSP platform subscription). customer.subscription.deleted cancels the subscription, suspends the MSP org, and records a canceled event.
notes: Epic #803 (Money-path lifecycle coverage). Drives the REAL msp-billing-webhook handleSubscriptionDeleted via the dev-origin-gated POST /api/admin/testbed/billing-simulate (same dispatchMspStripeEvent as production). Honest boundary + self-contained testbed setup: see payment-failed-dunning.json notes.

customer.subscription.deleted is what Stripe sends for an IMMEDIATE cancellation (and also when a scheduled cancel_at_period_end finally fires at period end). The real handler: msp_subscriptions.status → 'canceled'; msps.status → 'suspended' with suspended_at set; one msp.subscription.canceled event. All three are asserted against the DB.

GAP NOTE (documented, not asserted here): this wired path exists ONLY for the MSP platform channel. The direct-customer retainer channel (client_services) has NO customer.subscription.deleted handler — a retainer that actually cancels at period end never flips client_services.status to canceled; it stays 'active' indefinitely. See retainer-cancel-resume.json and the PLATFORM_BUILD.md row for this session.

apiTests.name: SETUP — testbed MSP subscription at clean active baseline
EXECUTE — customer.subscription.deleted (immediate cancel) through the real dispatcher
VERIFY — subscription status is now canceled

body.query: SELECT status FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — the MSP org was suspended

body.query: SELECT m.status FROM msps m JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = m.id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'
SELECT (m.suspended_at IS NOT NULL) AS suspended_set FROM msps m JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = m.id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — exactly one msp.subscription.canceled event was recorded

body.query: SELECT e.id FROM msp_event_store e JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = e.msp_id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed' AND e.event_type = 'msp.subscription.canceled'

postGraphApiTests.name: TEARDOWN — restore clean baseline (status=active, msp un-suspended)
